name: Waystone
descriptionSeed: Waystone — an outpost where bridge-builders and road-walkers meet. The masons build the crossing and the horizon folk tell them where it is actually needed, which is why the roads out of Waystone go somewhere useful.
encounterFlavor: two crews who share a yard, a road, and a long-running disagreement

substrateSource.reason: The stone is Precursor work — a marker whose purpose nobody remembers, still doing it. The settlement grew up around a thing that was already here.
substrateSource.radiusNote: `radius` is in legacy map units; `radiusWorld` is RADII on the sphere and is the one mechanics should use. Chosen by sweep against the authored worldPos: at this scale all 26 sources resolve on the correct side of their region baseline and calibration drift stays ~0.05. Larger radii blanket a whole region (a source at ~55% strength everywhere inside it) and renormalization cancels the field flat — the failure CCode measured and reverted.

axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder. ⚠️ An outpost balances EXACTLY TWO domains, so exactly two components are non-zero and both are modest — the signature that distinguishes an outpost from a foothill.
worldPosNote: ⛔ SNG-427: MOVED ONTO THE ECHO. Erik: 'Millbrook is the town closest to the Echo River crossing — that's why the crossing exists.' Measured before: Millbrook was 1382 mi from the Crossing and the Crossing was 100 mi from any water. Now 176 mi downstream, 6 mi off the channel. ⚠️ 'The masons BUILD the crossing.' Downstream of it and back from the water — a works yard needs stone and space, not a riverbank. Was colatitude 76, longitude 126.
_regionNote: ⛔ SNG-434: MOVED FROM `the_given_land` TO `valley`. I placed Waystone on the Echo in SNG-427 (its seed: 'THE MASONS BUILD THE CROSSING') and never updated its region, so it sat 2604 miles from its own region's other members and made `the_given_land` read as global. ⚠️ ALL FIVE NEAREST NEIGHBOURS ARE `valley`, and it is 15 MILES FROM THE CROSSING ITS MASONS BUILD. ⛔ THE SAME MISS AS ECHO RIVER CROSSING: I moved the position and forgot the region is a separate field.
